test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the parts to form a correct sentence:
(1) The project was ambitious.
(2) It required coordination across five teams.
(3) Regular meetings were held.
(4) Ultimately, everyone contributed effectively.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentences describe the process of completing an ambitious project that required collaboration and coordination.
 
• **Sentence 1** introduces the main idea of the project, making it the starting point of the paragraph: 
 
 
• "The project was ambitious."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 2** naturally follows as it elaborates on the challenges of the project:
 
 
• "It required coordination across five teams."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3** comes next as it describes the actions taken to address the challenges:
 
 
• "Regular meetings were held."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4** concludes the paragraph by highlighting the final outcome of the project:
 
 
• "Ultimately, everyone contributed effectively."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **1-2-3-4**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"The project was ambitious. It required coordination across five teams. Regular meetings were held. Ultimately, everyone contributed effectively."</div
